dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel-intensity transitions from dark charcoal surroundings to light-grey perimeters. The geometry of the top three annuli is characterized by non-uniform, jagged edges with high-contrast gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid light-grey pixel clusters localized within the central dorsal region. These clusters lack internal gradients and are interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form a wide-angled, obtuse triangle relative to the dorsal midline. A series of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a linear arrangement extending towards the posterior flank.
